name: Magic Mayhem with Dan Rhodes
overview: Dan Rhodes, the awe-inspiring close-up magician and social media superstar, hosts the first ever magic variety show: Magic Mayhem with Dan Rhones by pocket.watch. Join Dan in his enchanted workshop AKA The Dan Den, as he performs captivating illusions, gives advice to kid video stars like Ryan, Toys and Colors, The Stella Show, and others - and inspires kids of all ages to go after their dreams!
